title: session.rs sibling structs use inconsistent serde-attribute placement
description:
src/session.rs:21-23 ChatCapability uses two separate attribute lines:
```
#[serde(rename_all = "camelCase")]
#[serde(default)]
```
src/session.rs:79-81 ChatPushCapability uses the combined form:
```
#[serde(rename_all = "camelCase", default)]
```
Both compile; the difference is purely stylistic. AGENTS.md 'Canonical Templates' pushes cookie-cutter consistency hard between sibling types. Pick one form and apply uniformly. Combined form is one line shorter and matches AccountInfo precedent in base-client. (Note: the underlying #[serde(default)] is itself flagged by JMAP-26di.4 as a correctness issue — resolve that first; this is a cosmetic follow-up if both keep the attribute.)
close_reason: triage 2026-10-22 (moot, skeptic-confirmed): Both structs moved out of chat-client/src/session.rs into chat-types (commit b7c61d8d 'feat(chat-types): host ChatCapability/ChatPushCapability + URI consts'). They now carry the same single attribute: crate-jmap-chat-types/src/capability.rs:153 and :242 are both `#[serde(rename_all = "camelCase")]`, with no #[serde(default)] on either. | check: Both structs now live in crate-jmap-chat-types/src/capability.rs and carry the same single `#[serde(rename_all = "camelCase")]` (ChatCapability around :153, ChatPushCapability around :242). Neither has a struct-level serde(default); JMAP-26di.4 removed it and is closed. chat-client/src/session.rs on
